rows.why: Foreign evidence can be syntactically valid and PASS while belonging to another candidate.
PASS alone does not prove evidence came from the expected producer/gate/policy.
Stale evidence must not survive relevant candidate/policy/producer changes.
rows.invariant: Only explicitly compatible lineage versions/runs may be consumed; incompatible evidence is BLOCKED.

rows.why: A plausible transition snapshot does not prove provenance for the current candidate.
rows.invariant: Transition event has current candidateBinding and valid RFC3339 transitionAt.

rows.why: State-machine gaps can authorize illegal skips or misuse withdrawal.
rows.invariant: Only LAB>QUALIFIED, QUALIFIED>PUBLISHED, PUBLISHED>WITHDRAWN are lawful and requested edge equals actual edge; WITHDRAWN has no qualifying forward edge.

rows.why: Non-empty receipt/authority refs can still belong to another publication/candidate.
rows.invariant: Admission record receipt binding and authority provenance equal current candidate/Q5 provenance.

rows.why: A safe-looking route list can describe a foreign or non-publishable surface.
rows.invariant: Surface is bound to current candidate/publication, authorized publishable state, receipt/authority present, lab unreachable and missing evidence denied.

rows.why: Tooling dependencies can introduce vulnerabilities whose production reachability is unknown.
rows.invariant: Audit evidence classifies findings; production-reachable HIGH causes CI failure; tooling-only findings remain explicit evidence.
